title: Sparkline asks index and exec brief
content:
TL;DR:
Quick stitched synthesis of recent customer-voice micro-threads (May 2027) with prioritized feature asks and low-effort probes we can run in the next sprint. This is meant for exec alignment + a lightweight engineering handoff.

What this doc is:
- Not exhaustive — a compact index of repeated micro-asks that bubbled in support, SRE, and field conversations over the last 6 weeks.
- Focus: runtime friction (KV/cache misuse, cold-start latency), cost controls (per-token surprises), and rollout/observability gaps (hard to trace model fallbacks).

Signal summary (counts):
- 34 distinct customer mentions across support tickets and CSM calls.
- 12 accounts reported recurring latency spikes (>2x baseline) under steady load.
- 9 asks requesting more fine-grained rollout controls (e.g., route by latency SLA, not only region).
- 7 embedded feature requests for cheaper quantized variants with transparent quality notes.

Representative customer quotes (verbatim, anonymized):
- "We see intermittent 300–600ms jump on streaming tokens when switching prompt templates — hard to reproduce."
- "Can we get a fallback policy that sends only short responses to avoid cascades when the model is overloaded?"
- "We need a way to lock a model version for a given route during our fortnightly canary window."

Priority asks (ranked by frequency + impact):
1) Latency spike triage bundle (high impact, medium dev cost)
   - Problem: Customers observe unexplained mid-request latency jumps; often correlates with KV cache misses or cold key eviction.
   - Quick probe: Add lightweight request-level logging (sampled 0.5%) capturing KV cache hit/miss, batch size, seq_len, model-variant tag. Funnel into existing per-route latency dashboards.
   - Success metric: reduce unresolved spike incidents by 50% in 4 weeks (CS tickets closed w/root cause).

2) Canary pinning controls (medium impact, low dev cost)
   - Problem: Customers want deterministic pinning per-route during canaries (today rollout is global or tiered only).
   - Proposal: expose a route-level flag "pin_model_version" that overrides smart routing for a configurable window, plus telemetry tag.
   - Risk: increased capacity pressure if many customers pin high-cost models; propose soft quota and warning in console.

3) Quantized-variant transparency pack (medium impact, medium cost)
   - Problem: Demand for cheaper variants with clear guidance on quality delta and failure modes.
   - Proposal: publish a small "variant sheet" per model with expected relative delta (BLEU/ROUGE proxy or eval-set exemplar), token cost delta, and known hallucination/edge-case behaviors.
   - Implementation note: product + applied-ml to own a template; hosting team to surface in model-catalog.

4) Per-route fallback strategies (high impact, low dev cost)
   - Problem: When load spikes, customers would rather degrade to shorter outputs than fail requests.
   - Probe: Implement a fallback policy option that returns truncated responses or short-summary-only when endpoint latency > threshold. Toggle in console and SDK.
   - Measure: rollout with 3 beta customers and measure successful request-throughput preservation and CS satisfaction.

Low-effort experiments (can be done in 1 sprint):
- Sampled KV cache telemetry (0.5% traffic) feeding a cheap histogram: keys evicted, keys reused, average prefix length. Owner: SRE instrumentation.
- Rapid docs patch: "How to diagnose token-latency spikes" (2 pager + checklist). Owner: CS + DevEx.
- Small SDK flag: allow client to request "short-mode=true" which asks server to try to keep responses < N tokens. Owner: DevEx.

Cost & unit economics notes:
- Several customers call out opaque per-token charge when model variants are swapped by routing; propose exposing an estimated per-request cost preview in Console before rollout changes.
- Estimation probe: compute median tokens-per-request by route and show delta if a different model variant was applied (back-end only, UI experiment).

Open risk flags and unknowns:
- Autoscaler interaction: pin_model_version + autoscale could cause local saturation. Need load-projection guardrails. Engineering question: do we allow pinning to request additional reserved capacity automatically? (URGENT: ask infra team).
- Telemetry volume: sampled KV logs should be capped to avoid billing spikes for observability. Confirm expected cardinality and storage.
- Quality labeling for quantized variants: Who owns ongoing drift monitoring? Applied-ML or Optimize?

Suggested owners & next steps (proposed):
- Week 0 (this sprint): Add sampled KV cache telemetry + docs patch. Owners: Owen Brooks (SRE), Lena Torres (CS writer).
- Week 1: Implement "short-mode" SDK flag and console preview UI for per-request cost. Owners: DevEx squad + Console PM (Marcus Nguyen to coordinate).
- Week 2–3: Build route-level pinning feature prototype (API + opt-in console). Owners: Serving-runtime + Product-hosted-api; liaison: Aisha Patel.
- Week 4: Beta rollout of per-route fallback policy with 3 pilot customers. Owners: Solutions Engineering + SRE.

Measurement plan (how we know if this helped):
- Primary: number of repeat latency spike tickets (target: -50% vs baseline).
- Secondary: proportion of routes using pin_model_version and short-mode; number of successful graceful-degraded requests saved during overloads.
- Customer sentiment: CS satisfaction score from pilot customers (qualitative + 1–3 questions).

Meeting ask for leadership (for exec alignment):
- Approve "small probe bundle" funding (SRE time + 2 sprints of DevEx) to deliver sampled telemetry + SDK flag + docs. Estimated effort: 3 engineer-sprints total.
- Confirm ownership for model-variant quality sheets (Applied ML vs Optimize).

Appendix: tickets and examples to review (high signal)
- JIRA-CS-4821: recurring latency events for customer "A": traces attached (see last 3 occurrences).
- JIRA-ENG-9982: request for per-route rollout pin from large fintech customer.
- GH PR: probe-experiments/pull/317 — initial KV sampling patch (WIP).

Notes to self / unresolved follow-ups:
- Need concrete storage estimate for sampled telemetry (ask observability infra).
- Decide whether to surface cost preview purely in UI or as an API first.
- Follow-up sync with Applied ML on a template for variant quality sheets.

End of brief.

(If you want a condensed 1-slide exec snapshot, I can produce a one-pager with 3 bullets & cost ask.)
